summary: This directory manages the execution environment metadata, capturing essential system-level identifiers required to describe the service's current runtime state across distributed environments.
responsibilities: Identify current service host and network details
Provide consistent runtime environment context for service operations
relationships: The Runtime Context acts as a container for system-level data including the host name and network address.
The process identifier is maintained within the Runtime Context to uniquely track the lifecycle of the service instance.
designDecisions: Encapsulation of environmental identifiers within a single context class
